# Overview

Summarizes the fitted results saved by each language's PlotsAndCurves file and draws three figures. Does not refit any model.

1. **Sentential growth curves**: every fitted sentential word-by-scope curve, all languages on one plot, colored by language.
2. **Discourse growth curves**: the same for discourse.
3. **Onset estimates**: the lag estimate and 95% credible interval of every curve, with sentential and discourse distinguished by color and shape in one panel.

Lag is a growth-curve parameter, not the age of a child's first observed use.

Run each language's PlotsAndCurves file first. For every language, this file reads three files from `../<language>/<language>_data/processed_data/`:

- `<language>_sentential_negation_childdata.RDS` (columns `negation_category` or `word`, `age`, `cumulative_ppt`, `predictions`)
- `<language>_discourse_negation_childdata.RDS` (same columns)
- `<language>_negation_scope_age_of_production.RDS` (columns `category`, `word`, `Estimate`, `Est.Error`, `Q2.5`, `Q97.5`)

# Setup

Loads `tidyverse`, `ggrepel`, and `stringi`, configures the PDF graphics device, and creates `summary_dir`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringi)

# Unicode-capable device for 不/没 and pinyin tone marks.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "cairo_pdf", error = FALSE)

summary_dir <- "../summary"
dir.create(summary_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Configure Languages and Plot Options

Defines `combined_languages`, `combined_scopes`, and `combined_word_labels`, along with the color and curve settings used in the figures.

```{r settings}
# Languages in display order. Colors are the first six slots of a palette
# checked for color-blind separation; each language keeps its color in every plot.
combined_languages <- tibble::tribble(
  ~language,  ~slug,       ~color,
  "Mandarin", "mandarin",  "#2a78d6",
  "English",  "english",   "#eb6834",
  "French",   "french",    "#1baf7a",
  "Japanese", "japanese",  "#eda100",
  "Spanish",  "spanish",   "#e87ba4",
  "German",   "german",    "#008300"
) %>%
  mutate(data_dir = file.path("..", slug, paste0(slug, "_data"), "processed_data"))

combined_language_colors <- setNames(combined_languages$color, combined_languages$language)

# TRUE: skip a language whose files are missing (with a warning).
# FALSE: stop, so a figure never silently leaves a language out.
allow_missing_languages <- FALSE

# TRUE: divide each curve by its own maximum, so every curve runs from 0 to 1
# and the timing of growth is easier to compare across words with very
# different frequencies. FALSE: plot fitted cumulative occurrences per 1,000 tokens.
normalize_curves <- FALSE

# Mandarin curve files store the character; the onset files store character + pinyin.
combined_word_labels <- c("不" = "不 bù", "没" = "没 méi")

combined_scopes <- c("Sentential", "Discourse")

plot_base_size <- 16         # points (was 12)
plot_label_size <- 5         # end-of-line labels on the curve plots, in mm (5 mm ≈ 14 pt; was 3.2)
```

# Load and Validate Saved Results

Loads each language's curve and onset RDS files, standardizes their columns, and validates shared `language`–`category`–`word` keys.

## Define Result Readers

Defines `read_onsets()` and `read_curves()` to load saved RDS files, check required columns, and standardize word labels.

```{r readers, include=FALSE}
nfc <- function(x) stringi::stri_trans_nfc(as.character(x))

relabel_word <- function(x) {
  x <- nfc(x)
  matched <- x %in% names(combined_word_labels)
  x[matched] <- unname(combined_word_labels[x[matched]])
  x
}

handle_missing <- function(path) {
  msg <- paste0("Missing file: ", path,
                "\nRun that language's PlotsAndCurves file first, ",
                "or set allow_missing_languages <- TRUE.")
  if (allow_missing_languages) {
    warning(msg, call. = FALSE)
    return(NULL)
  }
  stop(msg, call. = FALSE)
}

check_columns <- function(data, required, path) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required, names(data))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop("File ", path, " is missing columns: ",
         paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  }
}

# One language's onset table, limited to sentential and discourse rows.
read_onsets <- function(language, data_dir, slug) {
  path <- file.path(data_dir, paste0(slug, "_negation_scope_age_of_production.RDS"))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(handle_missing(path))

  data <- readRDS(path)
  check_columns(data, c("category", "word", "Estimate", "Est.Error", "Q2.5", "Q97.5"), path)

  if ("language" %in% names(data) && any(as.character(data$language) != language)) {
    stop("File ", path, " contains rows for another language.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  data <- data %>%
    transmute(
      language = language,
      category = str_to_title(as.character(category)),
      word = relabel_word(word),
      Estimate, Est.Error, Q2.5, Q97.5
    )

  # Held-out labels (e.g. Spanish o_no, German kein_np) are not plotted.
  held_out <- filter(data, !category %in% combined_scopes)
  if (nrow(held_out) > 0L) {
    message(language, ": leaving out rows with category ",
            paste(unique(held_out$category), collapse = ", "))
  }
  filter(data, category %in% combined_scopes)
}

# One language's fitted curves for one scope.
read_curves <- function(language, data_dir, slug, scope) {
  path <- file.path(data_dir, paste0(slug, "_", tolower(scope), "_negation_childdata.RDS"))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(handle_missing(path))

  data <- readRDS(path)
  word_col <- intersect(c("negation_category", "word"), names(data))[1]
  if (is.na(word_col)) {
    stop("File ", path, " has neither a negation_category nor a word column.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  check_columns(data, c("age", "cumulative_ppt", "predictions"), path)

  data %>%
    transmute(
      language = language,
      category = scope,
      word = relabel_word(.data[[word_col]]),
      age = as.numeric(age),
      observed = as.numeric(cumulative_ppt),
      predictions = as.numeric(predictions)
    ) %>%
    # All-zero series have no fitted values.
    filter(is.finite(age), is.finite(predictions)) %>%
    arrange(word, age)
}
```

## Combine and Validate Results

Loads and binds each language's tables into `combined_onsets` and `combined_curves`, checks matching keys, and saves the results to `summary_dir`.

```{r load_results}
combined_onsets <- pmap_dfr(
  combined_languages %>% select(language, data_dir, slug),
  read_onsets
)

combined_curves <- combined_languages %>%
  select(language, data_dir, slug) %>%
  crossing(scope = combined_scopes) %>%
  pmap_dfr(read_curves)

combined_keys <- c("language", "category", "word")

if (anyDuplicated(combined_onsets[combined_keys]) > 0L) {
  stop("Duplicate language-category-word rows across the onset tables.")
}

# Every fitted curve should have an onset estimate, and the other way round.
combined_curve_keys <- distinct(combined_curves, across(all_of(combined_keys)))
combined_no_onset <- anti_join(combined_curve_keys, combined_onsets, by = combined_keys)
combined_no_curve <- anti_join(combined_onsets, combined_curve_keys, by = combined_keys)
if (nrow(combined_no_onset) > 0L || nrow(combined_no_curve) > 0L) {
  warning(
    "Curves and onset tables do not match.\n",
    "Curve without onset: ",
    paste(apply(combined_no_onset, 1, paste, collapse = " / "), collapse = "; "), "\n",
    "Onset without curve: ",
    paste(apply(combined_no_curve[combined_keys], 1, paste, collapse = " / "), collapse = "; "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

language_levels <- intersect(combined_languages$language,
                             unique(c(combined_onsets$language, combined_curves$language)))

combined_onsets <- combined_onsets %>%
  mutate(language = factor(language, levels = language_levels),
         category = factor(category, levels = combined_scopes))
combined_curves <- combined_curves %>%
  mutate(language = factor(language, levels = language_levels),
         category = factor(category, levels = combined_scopes))

saveRDS(combined_onsets, file.path(summary_dir, "combined_negation_scope_age_of_production.RDS"))
write_csv(combined_onsets, file.path(summary_dir, "combined_negation_scope_age_of_production.csv"))
saveRDS(combined_curves, file.path(summary_dir, "combined_negation_scope_curves.RDS"))

# What went into the figures.
combined_onsets %>%
  arrange(category, language, Estimate) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Estimate, Est.Error, Q2.5, Q97.5), ~ round(.x, 1)))
```

# Plot Growth Curves

Plots fitted `predictions` against `age` for each `word`, with color showing `language` and labels placed at line ends.

## Define Growth Curve Plot

Defines `plot_scope_curves()` to draw a growth-curve figure for each scope from `combined_curves`.

```{r curve_plot_function, include=FALSE}
plot_scope_curves <- function(scope) {
    plot_data <- combined_curves %>%
    filter(category == scope) %>%
    group_by(language, word) %>%
    # Observed and fitted values share one scale factor, so they stay comparable.
    mutate(
      scale_by = if (normalize_curves) max(predictions) else 1,
      y = predictions / scale_by,
      y_obs = observed / scale_by
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0L) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void() +
             labs(title = paste(scope, "Negation: no fitted curves")))
  }

  # Label each line at its last fitted point.
  line_ends <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(language, word) %>%
    slice_max(age, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(word, " (", language, ")"))

  y_label <- if (normalize_curves) {
    "Fitted cumulative rate (share of each curve's maximum)"
  } else {
    "Cumulative relative frequency (per thousand)"
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(age, y, color = language, group = interaction(language, word))) +
    geom_point(aes(y = y_obs), size = 1.3, alpha = 0.35, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = line_ends,
      aes(label = label),
      color = "grey25", size = plot_label_size,
      direction = "y", hjust = 0, nudge_x = 2,
      xlim = c(74, Inf),
      segment.color = "grey70", segment.size = 0.3,
      min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.2,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = combined_language_colors, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, 12), limits = c(0, 104),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(
      title = paste(scope, "Negation"),
      x = "Child Age (Months)",
      y = y_label,
      color = "Language"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.3), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "grey15"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

## Plot Sentential Growth Curves

Plots `combined_sentential_curve_plot` by calling `plot_scope_curves("Sentential")`.

```{r sentential_curves, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
combined_sentential_curve_plot <- plot_scope_curves("Sentential")
combined_sentential_curve_plot
```

## Plot Discourse Growth Curves

Plots `combined_discourse_curve_plot` by calling `plot_scope_curves("Discourse")`.

```{r discourse_curves, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
combined_discourse_curve_plot <- plot_scope_curves("Discourse")
combined_discourse_curve_plot
```

# Plot Onset Estimates

Plots `Estimate` with `Q2.5`–`Q97.5` intervals for each word, grouping rows by `language` and earliest onset. Uses `category` to color and shape the Sentential and Discourse estimates within each row.

```{r onset_plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
# Colors for the two scopes (shape is a second cue, so color is never the only one).
combined_scope_colors <- c(Sentential = "#2a78d6", Discourse = "#eb6834")
combined_scope_shapes <- c(Sentential = 16, Discourse = 17)

combined_onset_plot_data <- combined_onsets %>%
  filter(is.finite(Estimate)) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(word, " (", language, ")")) %>%
  # One row per word: grouped by language, words within a language by earliest onset.
  group_by(language, label) %>%
  mutate(row_first = min(Estimate)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(language, row_first) %>%
  mutate(
    row = match(label, unique(label)),
    # Top of the plot = first row; sentential just above discourse within a row.
    y = -row + if_else(category == "Sentential", 0.17, -0.17)
  )

combined_onset_rows <- combined_onset_plot_data %>% distinct(row, label)

combined_onset_plot <-
  ggplot(combined_onset_plot_data,
         aes(x = Estimate, y = y, color = category, shape = category)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5), size = 0.6, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = -combined_onset_rows$row,
                     labels = combined_onset_rows$label,
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, 6), expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 72)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = combined_scope_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = combined_scope_shapes, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated Onset of Negation",
    x = "Fitted lag (months), with 95% credible interval",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Dashed line: end of the 0–10-month zero baseline; estimates near it are left-censored."
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = plot_base_size) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.3), hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "grey15"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = rel(0.75), color = "grey40", hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

combined_onset_plot
```

# Save Figures

Saves `combined_sentential_curve_plot`, `combined_discourse_curve_plot`, and `combined_onset_plot` as RDS and PNG files in `summary_dir`.

```{r save_figures}
combined_figures <- list(
  combined_sentential_curve_plot = c(10, 6),
  combined_discourse_curve_plot  = c(10, 6),
  combined_onset_plot            = c(10, 6)
)

for (name in names(combined_figures)) {
  plot <- get(name)
  size <- combined_figures[[name]]
  saveRDS(plot, file.path(summary_dir, paste0(name, ".RDS")))
  ggsave(file.path(summary_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = size[1], height = size[2], dpi = 300)
}
```
